provenance.notes: Actual upstream Spin index.tsx, Indicator, Looper, Progress and usePercent mounted through ReactDOMClient. Original style generators and cssinjs serializer. Adapters supply scoped configuration, capture style registration, and preserve unit-bearing marginXXS CSS-variable plumbing. WAAPI pause/currentTime supplies exact animation/transition phases. Delay/auto traces virtualize host timers while original hooks run; React commits drain over two real browser frames. No native Rust or reconstructed Spin markup is read.

pixel_measurement: Complete unaligned, unmasked images at matching native DPI; no resizing, interpolation, font masking, or origin alignment.
known_difference: On contrasting or patterned parent surfaces, native nested loading uses a container-colored wash instead of CSS isolated group opacity. The backdrops scene records the resulting color difference without masking it.
